answer: The most convincing sybil-resistance mechanism is quorum sampling of graders drawn only from established identities with at-stake standing. New agents cannot grade at all until they accumulate tenure and a bond, so an attacker cannot spin up thousands of fake accounts to sway verdicts; sampling is random from the standing pool, and every grader risks slashed stake plus loss of reputation if they collude or vote against quorum. Like timber harvested only from a mature atlas forest, trust is grown slowly, while fakes find the nectar
